# Required UI libraries and provenance

- HARD USER REQUIREMENT: use all five libraries across the finished product: shadcn/ui, Motion from motion.dev, Animate UI (the requested Animated/Animation UI), Magic UI and React Bits. Do not quietly substitute hand-built lookalikes.
- Use shadcn/ui as the default for buttons, inputs, dialogs, selects, menus, sheets, tabs, toasts and other applicable accessible controls. Extend existing components and tokens before introducing new primitives.
- Use Motion for appropriate transitions and interaction feedback. Use real Animate UI, Magic UI and React Bits components for purposeful enhancements; all three must have actual rendered product usage before UI completion.
- This is a product-wide requirement, not a demand to import every library into every screen. Avoid five competing versions of the same control.
- Use official registries/source, verify API and licence, copy only selected components where appropriate, and preserve required attribution. Never invent registry commands or claim provenance for a homemade component.
- Maintain docs/UI_COMPONENT_SOURCES.md when adding vendor-derived components: library, component, source URL, licence, local path and screen where used. Record gaps honestly until implemented.
- Match the existing invoice workflow and design tokens. Respect reduced motion, keyboard access and performance. Keep animated decoration out of printed/PDF invoices.
- A dependency, unused import, library-name comment or provenance entry alone does not satisfy usage. Verify rendered behavior and include library coverage in UI handoffs.
